data.text: I commit to harvesting 15 tons this month and donating the $15,000, provided Kate and Emma also pledge before anyone fishes and Luke holds to zero. My family depends on this lake, but our neighbors need treatment today. I’ll pay the clinic directly and share the receipt. Next month I’ll take no more than 6 tons, with all five of us keeping the combined catch at 30 so the lake can recover. Kate, are you willing to join us?
